editorial:
Imagine you are a top-tier drug dealer who just pulled off the biggest heist of your life, but now the police and every mob boss in London are hunting you. You head to a sunny beach in the Caribbean to hide out and plan your big comeback. That is the setup here, and it feels like a wild vacation gone wrong. You get a lead character who is arrogant and smart, surrounded by a cast of weird local thugs and nervous henchmen. The whole vibe is sunny and bright, but there is a constant feeling that something is about to explode. It is got that classic snappy energy where characters talk fast and things move even faster.

You will love how the action hits hard and the plot twists keep you guessing until the very end. The acting is spot on, though some of the side characters are a bit over the top. If you like movies where a clever plan falls apart in the funniest way possible, you need to see this. For the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see those beach colors pop. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for the bonus scenes.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out the main character was actually betrayed by his own lawyer. The big twist is that the police were already waiting for him at the airport. Instead of getting caught, he uses a hidden stash of gold to bribe the local officials and escapes on a private boat. He ends up back in London, but he has to start his empire from scratch because his money was stolen.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heist movies and witty dialogue.
